hypothesis: W-R24/W-R25 failed order-preserving resampling. Test whether a fixed-width mask-aware supervised model trained on preregistered development-only local monotone retimings transfers to different unseen monotone retimings better than equal-budget clean-only training.
freeze: Fix every warp map, positive/negative generator, deterministic development warp assignment, split, model width, epochs, criteria and output before first-use; do not alter based on prior heldout W-R24/W-R25 outcomes.
generator: Use frozen original 16tick×4 channel affine development sequences, candidate global offset+17 and time-varying jitter amp1/2; fresh heldout affine/quadratic/xorshift, offset+79, noise amp3; all-zero candidate missing rows use previously frozen masks.
training: Same 16 development seeds×9 entities×3 local negative swap sites (tail indices 2,5,8)×2 jitter amplitudes×2 labels =1728 examples per arm. Fixed 16-weight+bias perceptron, zero init, 32 epochs, LR0.1, same first-channel/4-channel mask-aware feature. Control clean-only identity warp; intervention chooses development warp by (seed+entity+tail_swap_index+amp)%3. Positive and negative candidates share exact same warp and mask.
heldout: Three new monotone warp maps × three source generators × two missing-row counts (3,5), plus positive/negative pair of two unseen tail swaps10/11 and12/13; 18 heldout cells/arm and 16 disjoint heldout seeds.
outcomes: AUGMENTATION_TRANSFER if warp-augmented arm has >=0.80 accuracy in every one of 18 heldout cells and improves clean-only warped average by >=0.10; PARTIAL if intervention improves clean control aggregate by >=0.05 but misses strict criterion; NEGATIVE otherwise. Report per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN and train updates for both arms, keep negative evidence.
controls: No exposed W-R24/W-R25 heldout seeds reintroduced to training
Every monotone warp anchored at0, endpoint15, swap site11-14 preserved and not masked
No changed model width, learner budget, extra labels/sensors or test-time training
Frozen source Git identities before first use, original artifact and one final full Go regression
No accepted ref mutation or production authority
claim_limit: Synthetic supervised temporal learning under resampling, not generalized semantic reasoning.
